themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents performing autonomous or semi-autonomous research tasks, including data collection, analysis, and synthesis.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Covers the development, evaluation, and application of specific AI tools designed to assist with various research methodologies.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Highlights AI tools that aid developers in writing, debugging, and optimizing code, often integrated into IDEs.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Explores how AI is being integrated into the design process for user interfaces, products, and research artifacts.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Articles detailing AI's ability to condense large volumes of text or data into concise summaries for quick understanding.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Investigates the use of AI chatbots for information gathering, user interaction, and the implications of their accuracy and behavior.

themes.name: AI testing automation
themes.description: Focuses on AI's role in automating various aspects of software testing, including test case generation and execution.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Covers the application of AI in evaluating and improving the usability of products and systems.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Examines how AI is changing job roles, skills requirements, and the overall employment landscape.

themes.name: AI qualitative research
themes.description: Details how AI can be used to analyze and extract insights from qualitative data, such as interviews and open-ended feedback.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
